```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script computes the descriptive statistics of the AlPaCa and the reading measures for Supplements 8 and 3, respectively. It saves:

1. The AlPaCa descriptives by grade bin, with the mean item reached (Table S3).
2. The AlPaCa score distribution (Figure S3).
3. The reading measure descriptives (Table S8).
4. The reading measure score distributions (Figure S8).

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
```

# Paths

```{r}
scores_dir <- here("data", "scores")
alpaca_runs_file <- here("data", "data_cleaning_general", "alpaca-runs-clean.csv")
alpaca_trials_file <- here("data", "raw", "alpaca_trials.csv")
alpaca_corpus_file <- here("data", "raw", "alpaca_corpus.csv")

results_dir <- here("results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

scores_all <- read.csv(file.path(scores_dir, "scores_all_apps_rt-3-75_5-875-7917_math.csv"))

# Keep only students with at least one arithmetic task score
math_tasks <- c("arf_prod", "arf_2afc", "calf_prod", "calf_6afc")
scores_all <- scores_all[rowSums(!is.na(scores_all[, math_tasks])) > 0, ]

scores_all <- scores_all %>%
  mutate(grade_as_int = as.integer(case_when(user_grade_at_run == "Kindergarten" ~ "0",
                                             .default = user_grade_at_run)))
```

# Score distribution plot

```{r}
plot_score_dist <- function(var, title, binwidth, ymax, xlim = NULL){
  scores <- scores_all %>%
    dplyr::select(score = all_of(var)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(score))
  score_mean <- mean(scores$score)

  ggplot(scores, aes(x = score)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = binwidth, boundary = 0,
                   fill = "gray", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_density(color = "black", linewidth = 1, adjust = 1.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = score_mean, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "red") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, ymax, length.out = 5), limits = c(0, ymax),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black"))
}

axis_label <- function(label, rot = 0) textGrob(label, rot = rot, gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontfamily = "Arial"))
```

# Supplement 3

## Table S3: AlPaCa descriptives by grade bin

```{r}
alpaca_scores <- scores_all %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, grade_as_int, score = alpaca_score) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
  mutate(grade_bin = case_when(grade_as_int %in% c(0,1) ~ "K-1",
                               grade_as_int %in% c(2,3,4) ~ "2-4",
                               grade_as_int %in% c(5,6) ~ "5-6",
                               grade_as_int %in% c(7,8) ~ "7-8",
                               grade_as_int %in% c(9,10,11,12) ~ "9-12"))
```

### Item reached

```{r}
alpaca_runs <- read.csv(alpaca_runs_file)

alpaca_trials <- read.csv(alpaca_trials_file) %>%
  rename(ID = assessment_pid) %>%
  filter(run_id %in% alpaca_runs$run_id,
         assessment_stage == "test_response",
         ID %in% alpaca_scores$ID)

# Load the corpus to get item position
alpaca_corpus <- read.csv(alpaca_corpus_file)
corpus_position <- data.frame(problem_id_corrected = unique(alpaca_corpus$PID)) %>%
  mutate(position = row_number())

alpaca_trials <- alpaca_trials %>%
  left_join(corpus_position, by = "problem_id_corrected") %>%
  arrange(ID, server_timestamp)

get_stop_trial <- function(correct, window = 5, max_correct = 1) {
  for (i in seq_along(correct)) {
    if (i >= window && sum(correct[(i - window + 1):i]) <= max_correct) return(i)
  }
  length(correct)  # stopping rule never met: reached the end of the corpus
}

# Get the farthest item reached
alpaca_item_reached <- alpaca_trials %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(trial = row_number()) %>%
  filter(trial <= get_stop_trial(correct_clean)) %>%
  summarise(item_reached = max(position))
```

### Descriptives

```{r}
alpaca_scores <- alpaca_scores %>%
  left_join(alpaca_item_reached, by = "ID")

alpaca_descriptives <- bind_rows(mutate(alpaca_scores, grade_bin = "All"), alpaca_scores) %>%
  mutate(grade_bin = factor(grade_bin, levels = c("All","K-1","2-4","5-6","7-8","9-12"))) %>%
  group_by(grade_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean = round(mean(score), 2),
            sd = round(sd(score), 2),
            min = round(min(score), 2),
            max = round(max(score), 2),
            skew = round(psych::skew(score), 2),
            excess_kurtosis = round(psych::kurtosi(score), 2),
            mean_item_reached = round(mean(item_reached), 2))

alpaca_descriptives

write.csv(alpaca_descriptives, file.path(results_dir, "sup3_table1_alpaca_descriptives.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Figure S3: AlPaCa score distribution

```{r}
p_alpaca <- plot_score_dist("alpaca_score", NULL, 0.25, ymax = 0.48)

alpaca_dist_plot <- arrangeGrob(p_alpaca, left = axis_label("Density", rot = 90), bottom = axis_label("Score"))
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(alpaca_dist_plot)

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "sup3_figure1_alpaca_distribution.png"), plot = alpaca_dist_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# Supplement 8

## Table S8: Reading measure descriptives

```{r}
reading_measures <- c(SWR = "swr_score", SRE = "sre_score", PA = "pa_score")

reading_descriptives <- scores_all %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, grade_as_int, all_of(reading_measures)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(ID, grade_as_int), names_to = "measure", values_to = "score") %>%
  filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  summarise(grade_range = paste0(ifelse(min(grade_as_int) == 0, "K", min(grade_as_int)), "-", max(grade_as_int)),
            n = n(),
            mean = round(mean(score), 2),
            sd = round(sd(score), 2),
            min = round(min(score), 2),
            max = round(max(score), 2),
            skew = round(psych::skew(score), 2),
            excess_kurtosis = round(psych::kurtosi(score), 2)) %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = names(reading_measures))) %>%
  arrange(measure)

reading_descriptives

write.csv(reading_descriptives, file.path(results_dir, "sup8_table1_reading_descriptives.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Figure S8: Reading measure score distributions

```{r}
p_swr <- plot_score_dist("swr_score", "SWR", 0.5, ymax = 0.32)
p_sre <- plot_score_dist("sre_score", "SRE", 5, ymax = 0.024)
p_pa <- plot_score_dist("pa_score", "PA", 0.25, ymax = 0.48, xlim = c(-3, 3))

reading_dist_plot <- arrangeGrob(p_swr, p_sre, p_pa, ncol = 3, left = axis_label("Density", rot = 90), bottom = axis_label("Score"))
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(reading_dist_plot)

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "sup8_figure1_reading_distributions.png"), plot = reading_dist_plot, width = 16, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
